# Reference documents (not included)

Datasheets and application notes used for the validation targets and set-up choices.
Download from onsemi.com (Technical Documentation search):

- NTH4L022N120M3S/D, Rev. 9 - 1200 V, 22 mOhm M3S datasheet (validation target)
- NTH4L032N065M3S/D, Rev. 6 - 650 V, 32 mOhm M3S datasheet
- AND90315/D - Using SPICE models in LTspice (recommends the Alternate solver)
- AND9783/D, TND6260/D, TND6330/D - background on onsemi's physical, scalable models
- EVBUM2897/D - onsemi discrete double-pulse tester user manual
